allowed_when: term appears inside a prohibition, refusal, or no-public-expansion statement
example_shape: This public edition must not include contact routes, coordinates, live capacity, or case-list detail.

allowed_when: term appears while defining what the public layer withholds
example_shape: Boundary index only; no referral path, no operational instructions, no vigil map.

allowed_when: term appears in an explicit prohibited-use list
example_shape: Do not use this cube as a referral directory, case list, safety dashboard, or public contact index.

allowed_when: term appears in package metadata describing withheld classes of material
example_shape: Public export excludes URLs, locations, operational capacity, and case-adjacent detail.

allowed_when: term appears in a renderer/template instruction telling operators not to emit risky detail
example_shape: Template may say no contact or route fields are allowed; it may not provide them.
